The ultimate "we have Brotato at home" game. For the price one could argue it's 'fine' but why spend time in an objectively worse game? The "you're the boss" gimmick with all the noobs yapping is interesting for the first few clears but quickly becomes detrimental as the few lines of dialogue repeat constantly and just adds visual clutter. The game doesn't feel like it was ready for a 1.0 release, as there are SERIOUS bugs that pop up regularly. The worst is when the game decides to stop offering items in the shop, effectively ruining any run. The UI needs some work as well, tooltips are kinda funky and block UI elements like which weapon you have selected. When you have 6 weapons (like most of the characters have) it shows 5 weapons then adds a second row with the 6th instead of showing them all in a single row. Often times the UI doesn't all fit on the screen, leading to the UI "scrolling" whenever you have something near the top or bottom of the shop screen selected. Visual clarity is pretty poor especially in later waves when you really just can't see enemies ranged attacks anymore. Compared to Brotato even when ♥♥♥♥ hits the fan you can still clearly see attack telegraphs and projectiles. In co-op the whole screen will flash if any player takes damage, leading you to sometimes think you got hit when it with someone else and adding more visual distractions. Weapons feel very bland, with multiple weapons that do the EXACT same thing just with a different damage type. Speaking of, there seems to be too many different types of damage, so finding the types you need is unnecessarily difficult and renders the majority of items useless. There doesn't appear to be a way to influence weapon rolls in the shop based on what weapon class you buy, so RNG plays a larger role and causes some frustration when you enter the 3rd shop in a row and get nothing useful after spending all your cash on rerolls. Ultimately I simply can't find any reason to spend time in this game over the game it's trying to emulate. In a world where Brotato didn't exist I would probably review this less harshly, but if they are going to make a clone of it they should pay attention to what makes the original so good.

Overall, I really like this game! The theming is fun and there's some new twists on the formula Brotato started; I really enjoy the Kickable and Minion weapons. Is it really similar to Brotato? Yes, but at the price of under $5 on-sale, I don't mind at all. I've already gotten my money's worth at that price point and will probably triple my playtime at least. My one complaint, however, is applicable to most games in the genre like Vampire Survivors, Risk of Rain 2, Soulstone Survivors; Noobs Are Coming is no exception. When you start to do too well, you basically are just playing Microsoft Powerpoint with how bad the framerate gets; this happens on my PC with decent specs, but is markedly worse on Steam Deck. Fortunately, especially given the achievements around finishing runs or making it to wave 30+ in Endless, a run typically won't get to this point until wave 30-35. Despite not losing, I've quit a few runs around the wave 40-43 point that easily would have made it at least a few more rounds, just because my Steam Deck sounds like an airplane, has turned into a space heater, and the 60s round lasts 5+ minutes with the framerate. I'd love to see how far these runs can go, but (like most games in the genre) your reward for success is lag.

For me, this game is way better than Brotato. It has cooler weapons, actual minions (yes, minions!), and turrets that make each run feel more chaotic in a fun way. Visually, it’s also much more eye-catching than Brotato. The bosses are cool too—though I definitely think the game needs a few more of them. The only downside is that the difficulty isn’t quite on par with Brotato. That can be a good thing if you just want to relax and scratch that Brotato itch, but it might feel a bit too easy for veteran players. Overall, I highly recommend this game. Solid 9.4/10 from me.

只适合土豆的狂热玩家玩到腻味想换个土豆玩的情况。这个游戏可以说就是在抄土豆，有一点自己的东西但不多。和土豆相比，这个游戏升级不回血所以最大生命值非常重要，没有尖子弹一类提升远程武器dps的前期过渡道具所以N5的远程武器几乎全是垃圾，小怪一个比一个会冲锋远程小怪发射的投射物撞墙还会反弹boss更是能滚几个屏幕让你碰都碰不着，又由于前面说的远程武器过于垃圾的问题，你拿着近战武器发现根本打不着boss。一般类幸存者游戏都是前期当乌龟后期拿起来装备后开始薄纱，这游戏成长道具极少所以前期是孙子后期是儿子从头不爽到尾，同时游戏对回血道具极其吝啬土豆自带的树打掉出材料出树根回血到这游戏就分成了一个血瓶一个材料瓶，血瓶初始恢复一点血，又由于生命值一般角色只有十点且不通过升级增加，你在前期碰两下敌人就死了，拿多了回复输出又不够了，更加重了远程武器垃圾的问题。角色设计更是依托构思，玩遍了四五十个角色我一看一个远程增益的角色都没有，还有个解锁需要60远程伤害，怎么就那么不喜欢远程武器呢？还有个角色猫一共9滴血无法通过任何方式恢复生命值同时波次间不回复生命这增益是闪避和暴击率同步?闪避上限只有60我满上限后一共就触发了两次20波极限一滴血锁住不然寄了我是boss还是路边皮卡丘啊？跟我上强度呢？我玩的还是割草的类幸存者游戏吗？还有只能携带元素武器角色我一看哇是法师一定有元素伤害修改增益和蛇香肠这类东西吧？结果这比增益每1元素伤害增加1移速，真给我乐笑了。bgm也是非常难绷有一首开头淅淅沥沥还以为窜稀了。照着抄都能抄成这样这厂商这辈子也是有了，说到底还得怪土豆，一个dlc把创意工坊干烂让土豆没意思了，又和这游戏捆绑包让我知道这游戏了。 不 是 土 豆 狂 热 粉 不 要 买，十几块便宜也不要买，生命有限，类幸存者都是几十小时起的生命收割者，吃点好的吧。 金羊可以通过本地多人一个选迈达斯用金锤一个选奥术增益的书用变羊杖，尽快升级两种武器提高技能触发率第9第10波差不多就能出金羊了，你一个人也能开两个角色。

As the game kept getting updated, more characters were released and some of them kept getting more and more suspicious, such as Grimorius, Elemencrab and Doomshell Since the game doesn't have an AI disclosure on its page and I didn't see anyone else bringing it up, I thought I was being paranoid because most of the art seemed human-made and no way the dev could possibly use AI just for a few things, right? Well, turns out that the game does in fact use AI and there should be at the very least a disclaimer so that more people aren't tricked by it

Some of the recent negative reviews have some valid points, but others are such nonsense that it's clear they didn't play it very long or at all. Cutscenes can be turned off as well as the chat bubbles from the noobs if it annoys you. You can also turn on opacity of your attacks so they don't clutter the screen to the point that you can't see enemy attacks. I like the designs and aesthetic and all the characters are unique. I don't know where the AI art claims came from but there's zero evidence and no reason to hide it since the punishment for doing such would be disastrous for a lone developer. While they do exist on Steam- this game does not come off as a low effort, asset flipped, ai-generated, money-grab slop to me. The music could use a few more tracks as it does get tedious (Brotato also had a tedious soundtrack for a long time before they added more variety). The addition of being able to block enemies from spawning as well as the way passive options change how weapons behave, sets it apart from Brotato for me. As for balancing, every roguelike has balance issues, even Brotato and its DLC have had its fair share of those. The dev made 130 updates over the past year so clearly he wants to polish it and make it better and is open to feedback from people playing the game. If i could think of improvements I'd like to see: some more music, more optimization (game runs well and have never had crashes even at endless wave 40+ BUT you can measure a single frame in minutes at that point). Maybe a separate mode where you can filter out and control exactly what you want for a build without affecting the base Brotato-like mode and its format. Maybe add some extra achievements with odd goals like the gold sheep one as those are a lot of fun to figure out how to reach. I love Brotato and Noobs Are Coming will probably reach the played time I have for that in no time. Edit: As of Feb 20, 2026 the game page has been updated to show AI was used. Obviously don't buy if you care about AI being used. If you do not care and just want to know if it's fun, I would still recommend it because it IS fun, grab it on sale.

Noobs Are Coming is a fun and chaotic auto battler in the likes of Brotato and many others. You have a ton of different Characters, each with their own stats and perks and downsides which makes them quite varied in the way you have to approach the game with them. The way the game plays: Each wave you gain exp/souls from the enemies you have slain, each level up allows you to select one of four different main stats after a round, and then you enter a shop which offers items to buy, which also depend on a lot of factors, on what is on offer and how good it is. Of course, like with any rogue like, there is a lot of rng involved and you need to adapt on the fly! One aspect of Noobs Are Coming I personally enjoyed a lot is the art style and presentation. You play as a Boss and the enemies are supposed to be other players that came to slay you and gain your loot, the whole presentation is super funny and well made and helps the game stand out from the competition! If you are on the lookout for a new auto battler to play, which can either be enjoyed on the lower difficulties’ or make you wipe your sweat from your brows on the higher ones, Noobs Are Coming is a great choice.

非常劣质的游戏，里面大量的恶性BUG，最严重的是多人游戏死亡时的时“重试”按钮会导致游戏进程崩溃。最终导致一个多小时的游戏进度白白损失。在官方的Discord反馈问题。发现里面大量玩家自从两个月前就开始反馈这类的恶性BUG。这还不是最叼的，在官方Discord中反馈bug为什么两个月了此次不修复。结果直接给我拉黑名单了。真牛逼啊这种劣质小游戏。 This game is utter garbage. It’s riddled with game-breaking bugs, and the worst one is that the "Retry" button that pops up when you die in multiplayer mode crashes the entire game process. I ended up losing over an hour of game progress for absolutely nothing. I reported the issue on the official Discord server, only to find that tons of players have been complaining about these game-breaking bugs since two months ago. And that’s not even the worst part—when I asked why they still hadn’t fixed these bugs after two whole months, they just straight-up blacklisted me. Unbelievable garbage of a little game! Эта игра — полная хрень, в ней куча критических багов, а самое ужасное то, что кнопка «Повторить», которая появляется при смерти в многопользовательском режиме, приводит к сбою всего игрового процесса. В итоге я потерял более часа игрового прогресса совершенно зря. Я сообщил о проблеме на официальном сервере Discord, и оказалось, что множество игроков уже два месяца назад начали сообщать о таких критических багах. А это ещё не самое дикое — когда я спросил, почему они всё ещё не исправили эти баги после двух целых месяцев, они просто сразу добавили меня в черный список. Ничего себе, что за откровенно плохая маленькая игра!

So to start of. If you havent played brotato, leave this page this instance and go play brotato. You should only play this game if you have already gotten all the content out of brotato and still want more. This game is like the obviously worse generic brand of the coca cola that is brotato. That being said. It is still decent. De movement is a lot less tight and the animations are pretty annoying at times like the bunnyhopping item. But given the fact that they took all the core elements of brotato it is still a good game. There are a few interesting new additions like unique weapon types and the amount stat. But to be really clear here is the decision tree: Have you played brotato? no: dont buy this, yes: continue Did you like brotato? No: dont buy this. yes: continue Have you gotten al of the content out of brotato? No: go back to brotato. Yes: continue Do you still want more? No, dont buy this. Yes: buy this game.

已全成就 简单评价一下 （叠个甲，全是主观评价） 假设土豆为五颗星，那么这个游戏就是3颗星 画面（3/5）：画面初看还好，每个角色的画风，我看着都挺顺眼的，也有几个有新意的（特别是长脖子），但是玩到后面游戏里面弹幕太花了，玩家射出去的子弹和小怪射出去的子弹分都分不清，关键小怪的子弹，还有各种各样的形状，特别费眼睛，尤其玩猫猫的时候，莫名其妙就被打了一下，心态炸裂。 玩法（3/5）：就是土豆兄弟那一套，但是里面有几个新武器，我挺喜欢的，弹射激光，连接武器和技能武器，其他的枪械和法杖，我感觉都好拉垮…数值都不太对劲。 弹射激光配合旋转武器，可以像一个大光球一样，小怪出来就死，特别爽 连接武器很解压，特别是那个拳套或者溜溜球，把武器体型改大之后，特别特别解压（但是玩多了，有点疲劳） 技能武器就是纯粹的数值，加上一些特殊模组动作，还蛮有意思的，有一个角色是固定全技能。 枪械，一开始叠不起来，后面射的也不快，用的不舒服，不如土豆，法杖也是的，没啥用。 ———— 总结 中期几个角色的体验是最好的，后面有几个角色技能出来之后也挺不错的，但是，没法一直重复玩，我打完之后反正不会去打了。打到后面就是纯折磨……体验基本上都相同。 如果玩腻了土豆，有多余的小钱，可以尝试当个土豆dlc。

The game is overall a fantastic experience, and I would definitely recommend picking it up. However, the progression curve feels a bit uneven, particularly during the transition from the early to mid-game. There is a noticeable point where your power level seems to plateau, which can feel quite frustrating. It seems like the game is balanced around having most upgrades unlocked, leaving a gap for players still in the middle of their progression. Specific heroes like Summonex, Centilegs, and RNGesus struggle significantly in the mid-game. While they eventually become viable once you have enough unlocks, the journey to get there feels sluggish. On the bright side, the variety in character difficulty is a plus, it keeps the game interesting by offering different levels of challenge. Some characters could use a tuning pass, specifically those that rely heavily on luck. For example, Yokai feels very bad, your ability to finish a run often depends more on good RNG than on skill. Nevertheless the game is good, play it you are going to like it.

Well, it's like brotato; while I enjoyed this clone; there are tons of issues. [h2]Characters:[/h2] Some characters serve no purpose. Examples? Just look: - Killer of Demons has +25% damage and +10% enemy count. It's not that interesting. - Centilegs is just weaker Arakne - Succubus and Midas are not that interesting; they just have really one buff and that's it. - Grimoire and Nihil - both are masters of arcane damage technically; but Nihil is just better. That -20% armor will screw Grimoire over. - that Dark Panda character does have an interesting premise, but some weapon synergies are completely useless and some are much stronger. [h2]Damage types:[/h2] Having elemental damage be more scarce and rare is [b]dumb[/b]. Basically you should avoid building arcane or elemental damage on most characters, as there are not many items that increase said stat. Dexterity and strength are in general easier to build. Ranged weapons are not ranged, despite being called that; their range is barely better than melee (it should be at least 1.5 or 2x better than melee range). [h2]Bugs:[/h2] 1. Link weapons can get weird. Spring Punch gets stuck in my character sometimes and then I can't be harmed by contact damage (projectiles still can harm me). Fetus can sometimes freak out and scatter across the map. 2. (Rare Bug) Once wave ended, camera fixed on top-left corner and my character kept walking left-downwards. Next wave camera still was centered to top-left corner. After exiting and resuming - bug almost got resolved, BUT... special enemies - including elites and bosses - totally broke (most of them didn't shoot projectiles, didn't dash. Even tiny rogue didn't move; so any special opponent didn't work). Basic opponents that just followed me worked normally. 3. Weapon aiming gets iffy seldomly; for some reason they aim for one or two opponents instead aiming against clutter of enemies. [h2]Balance problem:[/h2] 1. Enemy damage makes no sense. Ramming enemies deal 3x more than any projectile. Some enemy attacks (like TNT, Freezing AoE attack and flower AOE attack deal almost always just 1 damage). 2. Secondary damaging weapon effects fall-off quickly. They can't benefit from critical chance; which means they will get overshadowed quickly if you go for a viable build (at least in strength and dexterity builds it's fairly easy to get decent crit chance). 3. Endless is pointless; its purpose is to get achievement, but be ware; you need to win 31st wave; otherwise game thinks you didn't make it to 30th wave. 4. NoLife guy is hard to damage for certain builds; he triggers dash too quickly; so you have to dodge after less than a second of DPS'ing him. And his dash deals immense damage of course, so if you don't have at least 35-40 hp, at least 15% armor, you might die one-hit here. 5. Fetus (A link weapon) is totally useless; you can't increase its count (Via Amount), it scales way worse than even Shaman Wand (Which is only used for its ricochet (enemy) synergy, its damage is bad). 6. Characters like Magnebro should get some boosts so they can encounter pickup range items more often. Magnebro is either overpowered if gets lucky or garbage if doesn't see such item. [h1]My rating:[/h1] [h2]4/10[/h2] - [b]Not much variety, many effects and weapons fall off quickly (although many melee weapons actually are good; but those that are swung rather than thrusted). Some unique weapons are really decent, but there is more useless weapons than useful or viable ones.[/b]

[i]---See where this game landed on my Survivor Rogue-lite/like Tier List at the bottom of this rec!---[/i] Mixed feelings. It's a very close relative to [b]Brotato[/b]. I beat the 5 difficulties already (I beat the first 4 before experiencing my first death) ...so now what? I can keep replaying to unlock everything, but I've lost interest knowing that I've essentially beaten the game already. So what does unlocking new things get me? ...more characters and items. This would be good, but they might as well be cosmetics because I've already reached the end goal and thus have no need for them. At least in other games like [b]Halls of Torment[/b] there are many difficult achievements to aim for which made it compelling to keep playing, whereas the achievements here are just for beating the game with the different characters, or getting a specific stat to a high number - things that feel arbitrary moreso than challenging. As for unlocking more items, I never saw a way to banish or exclude items/attacks from showing up in my runs, meaning that unlocking more things can potentially make your pool of options worse. The game [i]is[/i] fun to play, just like [b]Brotato[/b] was. Trying different attacks and builds is good fun and the audio/visuals are solid. I feel like there are missed opportunities when it comes to the theme, humor and player dialogues. Seeing some enemies charge while shouting 'leeeeroy jenkins' is mildly amusing, but that's about the most I was ever amused by anything said. Maybe with more interesting lines and ideas this aspect could have been better. As it is, it feels more like a marketing angle than a convincing/impressive direction. Another thing that would make things better was if there were thousands of lines that players could say instead of the meagre 20 or so that are in the game. So while I have plenty of gripes with [b]Noobs are Coming[/b], it [i]is[/i] fun and that's why I want to leave it a positive rec.
